verdict.rationale: RudderStack has its own event-driven rule mechanisms. Tracking Plans let you set predefined rules that catch non-compliant events in transit and fix or filter them, and Transformations run custom JavaScript or Python on every event to filter, enrich or reshape it before delivery. These are narrow, data-pipeline-focused rule actions rather than a general rule-to-action automation engine. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rule builder that triggers arbitrary downstream actions on events, documentation of the available rule conditions and action types, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Set predefined tracking plans to catch issues in transit, then fix and filter data before it impact downstream teams.
Tracking Plans Monitor and act on non-compliant event data at the source
Transformations let you filter, enrich, and reshape event data before it reaches your destinations.
